_comment: Prompt Guru tool syntax rules. Each entry defines how the final prompt must be formatted for that tool. Edit this file to tune output or add tools — no Worker code changes needed. The Worker fetches this from the live site at /prompt_formats.json.

midjourney.label: Midjourney
midjourney.style: comma-separated descriptive phrases with parameter flags
rules: Comma-separated descriptive phrases, not full sentences
Order: subject first, then style, then lighting/mood, then composition
End with parameter flags: aspect ratio as --ar W:H, version as --v 6
If the user wants to avoid something, use --no <thing> flag
Keep under 350 characters before flags
midjourney.example: golden retriever astronaut floating inside a space station, photorealistic, warm rim lighting, shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm lens --ar 16:9 --v 6

dalle.label: DALL-E
rules: Write as one or two natural, flowing sentences
No flags, no parameter syntax, no tag lists
Be explicit about style (e.g. 'a photorealistic photo of', 'a watercolor illustration of')
State composition and lighting in plain language
Mention what to avoid in plain words if needed
dalle.example: A photorealistic photo of a golden retriever wearing a NASA spacesuit floating inside a space station, warm light from a window, gentle and playful mood, centered composition.

stable-diffusion.label: Stable Diffusion
stable-diffusion.style: tag-style prompt plus separate negative prompt
rules: Main prompt: comma-separated tags and short phrases, most important first
Include quality tags like 'highly detailed, sharp focus' where appropriate
Always provide a separate 'Negative prompt:' line listing what to avoid
No sentence structure needed — density of relevant tags matters more
Keep main prompt under 300 characters
stable-diffusion.example:
golden retriever in astronaut suit, space station interior, photorealistic, highly detailed, warm lighting, sharp focus, 85mm
Negative prompt: blurry, cartoon, extra limbs, text, watermark

ideogram.label: Ideogram
ideogram.style: natural sentences, strong at rendering text in images
rules: Natural descriptive sentences
If the image should contain visible text, put the exact text in double quotes
State the style plainly (poster, logo, photo, illustration)
Mention color palette if the user expressed one
ideogram.example: A retro travel poster of a space station with the text "GREETINGS FROM ORBIT" in bold vintage lettering, warm sunset palette, clean vector illustration style.

sora.label: Sora
rules: One flowing cinematic paragraph, no flags or tags
Describe the scene, then the motion, then the camera behavior
Use concrete camera language: 'slow dolly in', 'static wide shot', 'handheld tracking shot'
Describe lighting and atmosphere explicitly
Keep under 600 characters
sora.example: Gentle ocean waves rolling onto an empty beach at golden hour, warm sunlight glinting off the water. Static wide shot, slow rhythmic motion, calm meditative atmosphere with soft ambient haze.

runway.label: Runway
runway.style: concise cinematic description with explicit motion
rules: One short paragraph, motion-focused — Runway responds strongly to movement verbs
Name the camera move explicitly ('slow pan left', 'aerial pullback', 'locked-off shot')
Describe subject motion separately from camera motion
No negative prompts — not supported
Keep under 450 characters
runway.example: Slow aerial pullback over calm ocean waves at sunset, waves rolling gently toward shore, warm golden light, soft atmospheric haze, smooth continuous camera motion.

kling.label: Kling AI
kling.style: detailed scene description with physical realism cues
rules: Describe the scene in natural sentences with strong physical detail
Kling excels at realistic physics — describe how things move and interact
Specify shot type and duration feel (brief clip vs continuous take)
State the mood and lighting
kling.example: A close-up of ocean waves curling and breaking in slow motion at sunset, water droplets catching golden light, realistic fluid physics, cinematic shallow depth of field, serene mood.

pika.label: Pika
pika.style: short punchy description with style modifiers
rules: Short and direct — one or two sentences
Lead with the subject and action
Add style modifiers at the end (cinematic, anime, 3D render, claymation)
Mention camera motion simply if needed ('camera slowly zooms in')
pika.example: Ocean waves rolling onto a beach at sunset, camera slowly pans across the water, cinematic, warm tones, peaceful.
